column1: # ZAP rule overrides for ci/scripts/zap-scan.sh (baseline + API scan).
# Anything not listed keeps ZAP's default (WARN), and warnings never fail
# the build (-I). Promote a rule to FAIL only after reviewing a real
# report; every IGNORE needs a one-line reason.
# FAIL — injection classes. All PASS on the first real scan (2026-09-27, 54 URLs from the OpenAPI spec); any regression blocks.
# FAIL — headers helmet sets today (main.ts); blocks if helmet is removed or misconfigured.
# IGNORE — reviewed false positives / informational on the first real report.

column3: Timestamp Disclosure - Unix: only hit is 1518500249 in /api/docs/swagger-ui-standalone-preset.js = SHA-1 round constant 0x5A827999, not a timestamp
Modern Web Application: informational only (Swagger UI is a JS app)
Storable and Cacheable Content: informational; hits are unauthenticated 404s (/, /api, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml) and the Swagger UI page

Cross Site Scripting (DOM Based): launches a headless browser per URL; on the 1.5 GB ZAP container it got the JVM OOM-killed mid-scan (rc=3, 2026-10-01). Target is a JSON API with no DOM; reflected/persistent XSS (40012/40014) stay FAIL
